verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe a RESTful API with JWT authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey) and global and China API endpoints. Per-unit pricing is listed for text-to-video, image-to-video and video generation calls, which shows video jobs can be submitted programmatically. The MCP/CLI offering is further evidence of programmatic generation at scale. Missing for 10: documentation of the async job submission/status-polling or callback flow, explicit evidence of how the finished asset is retrieved (download URLs, retention), and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end API workflow.
